report.explanation: The only evidence is a single trace pair for order POST /v1/orders: one 200 OK and one 503, both spanning 100ms. This is contradictory, not a bounded fault signature. No deployment facts, memory-retention data, or additional telemetry exist to localize a cause. Operator hypothesis cannot be confirmed or refuted; handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Additional traces or metrics for order POST /v1/orders over a wider window to establish error rate and whether 503s are sustained or isolated
Downstream dependency telemetry (DB, payment, inventory) to identify the source of the 503
Deployment records for the order service around the incident window
Logs from the order service at the time of the 503 response
